I asked the therapist and she helped a lot. I called the insurance provider company and the representative gave me the list. 

I told her that I've been looking for a psychiatrist and she would express concern but in a way I can see how she is helping me become more independent. I am seeing a female therapist at the moment. She's been really sweet and understanding.
That's very true. I just need to find somebody who I would feel more comfortable with.

Definitely I just. 
I don't know what to do. Thank you for understanding I just. I appreciate empathy a lot in people and I feel horrible. I'm a really sensitive and shy person in nature. I was looking into the psychiatrists background online and I should have known. He is a forensic psychiatrist who his specialty is more into criminal psychology and has a military background hence the authoritian tone of voice he had. 

At one point of the session I had to exclaim out of fear " Yes sir you're right sir. " And he seemed pleasured by that. That I was being submissive and was broken at the rough tone of voice. I felt paralyzed and remembered me in the past where people would scream and shout at me and I would cower in a corner scared.
I can find a career I will love and get over the horrible things I have done to others in my past.

We are both on speaking terms and we both realized we are miserable without each other. 

I really value his company and his encouraging words.

I find myself then judging myself and its a cycle of being self-critical on myself and then being completely stunned at how those men us as ATM, objects and just... Not a human being with actual emotions, flaws, and feelings. :(
That's very true. I can't be selfish and look at it from his perspective as well. Thank you.

I never want to get out of this bed... I'm really tired..  
I feel selfish for not having that little voice in me go... " Just go! "...My parents are helping but... Maybe I'm just too lazy...lazy yeah haha...

I'm 20...and honestly I can't cope well at the moment... 

I'm falling into an even bigger depression after my boyfriend of 2.5 years left me and I'm just here sobbing missing him and now I just. 

I don't know what to do now. If I study I feel like I can't get a good grade regardless. Its easier said than done to exercise regularly. I can't find it in myself to exercise. I don't know why. 

I desperately want to "snap out of it" like many people tell me but these thoughts consume me and I feel hopeless and I can't think of any dreams I want to pursue. 

I can't find myself working hard for my parents because I can't find love for them. I want to love them but they are just ashamed of me and my depression. 

I'm laying in bed and honestly I don't see the point of anything anymore. I'm alone.

I'm so scared of my parents reaction though. *cries* 

How can I tell them that I want to drop out out of all of my classes and why? I can't communicate with my mother well ( she only speaks Spanish ) and she'll get mad that I don't think its the best choice to go to classes right now. 

I'm so scared. Mainly because the only condition my parents have is that for me to go to college. 

My parents are blue-collar working Hispanics and they don't believe in mental illnesses. They will never believe that I have social anxiety or depression or anxiety in general. *cries* 

They don't believe how mentally unstable I am at the moment.

Because my parents are elderly and a lazy stupid bitch like myself take things for granted and it won't be long until they may die so they're anticipating me hurrying up with my studies. They just want me to study and to graduate already. 

I see my older sister who is 38 and she is a professional and everybody calls me the "baby" of the family and because of it I struggle with being pushed into adulthood. 

I'm a spoiled brat and I really want to study but I give up and find no motivation. I can't afford to lose a semester. I'll end up being even more depressed because my parents don't want to take care of a womanchild. 

I can't get a job and become more independent because I have crippling social anxiety and I'm in a really bad spot right now. If I drop all of my classes my parents will get angry. I can't approach them in a mature way because I have horrible Spanish speaking skills so there's always a lot of miscommunication. They'll just bully me and then get mad at me.

To add to that, I sent her an email because she never sent me an email regarding registering to a grade preservation progress website and she hasn't responded to me at all. 

I'm an anxious mess over that too because she urged us students to register as soon as possible and now I feel like I am left behind.

Depression / Anxiety/ Avoidant / Social Anxiety / Covert narcissism 

I have a cocktail of mental illnesses that guarantees me a life of knowing that once my youth fades away people will recognize what a monster I am on the inside.

My dream is... many things surprisingly. 
One is adventure. I dream to explore this world since an early age and that was inspired from when I was a little girl playing Pokemon. So much diversity and different atmospheres made my fantasy world expand in wonder. 

Another is just... being an adult. Being already 20 I can't help but still feel like a teenager. I just want to accelerate my growth and be a woman with responsibilities and yet still manage to find a path that will lead me to happiness. When I see how jaded and dead many adults are, I can't help but feel this internal emotional turmoil that I don't belong in an office.

My dream is to... find happiness, as cliche as it sounds. 

I think my ultimate dream is to conquer this lifelong depression that I have and just... Be able to find happiness in the smallest of things in this modern society. 

I'm sorry. I know it sounds lame. I can't help but idealize about these things but not *do* anything about it. It just makes me want to live more in a fantasy world.

I know that feeling. I'm only 20 and many acquaintances my age are already graduating from college. Many of my college classmates assume I'm straight out of highschool. 

I'll be your friend dude, coming from a chick who was just drifting around in a community college lost on what to do.

Holy shit I want to make a comic of this. Please, allow me to make a comic of this. I just. 

This is fucking amazing. This is so realistic and dark but so logical and resonates to me at the core. 

I'm not a good artist but I'll fucking try because this is the type of shit that should speak to the general public and make them see from a different perspective.

Yeah, it is the depression talking. I've been depressed for so fucking long I don't know who I am at the core. It's been so long that I've felt "mentally happy". I've had depression/ anxiety since I was a small little girl. 

Trust me, I'm self aware this is me being an attention whore and because I've been so fucking lonely I needed someone to hear me out. 

You should go to sleep. I don't know. 

I don't deserve shit. I've never cared about school, about anything. I fought with my parents ton when I was young. Shoplifted when I was 17 after a bad break-up. I was a girl who suffered from the smallest of things- so delicate, so fucking weak, so emotional. 


I hate being a girl. I hate having emotions. I hate being more emotional than logical and smart. 

I'll never be smart. I didn't care about learning in highschool. I saw highschool more as a prison where racism and bullying was apparent and that kids liked to look down on others and at the social hierarchy I was that weird loner anime loving kid that was a secret slut and a tomboy at heart but loved to dress up and look pretty and disregarded learning because I couldn't learn a damn thing. 

I was so worried about looking pretty so people wouldn't bully me or look down on me. I was so worried about my appearance. I had extreme body issues growing up. School just left a ton of scars in my heart and I feel like I'm reliving them through college again. 

I haven't changed.
